textEdits.announcement-text: Save Earth 🌍 · Save Soil ✨ · Support Local 💪 · Support Women 🧑‍🎓 · Use code LASA10 for 10% off
textEdits.hero-title: “Chocolate is the art of turning cocoa into pure emotion.”
textEdits.hero-subtitle: Welcome to Lasa Chocolates by Lakshitha. A serene, joyful celebration of artisan confections — from delicate rose-infused white chocolate to slow-baked fudge brownies, roasted dry-fruit jewels, and crunchy kunafa chocolates.
textEdits.catalog-desc: Browse our authentic chocolate flights, exotic specialities, and bakery batches.
textEdits.builder-desc: Choose any 10 of your favourite handcrafted pieces for just ₹179! Pick from rich dry fruits, rose-infused white chocolate, cherry, caramel, or classic silky chocolates.
textEdits.brownie-title: The Artistry of Our Homemade Brownies
textEdits.brownie-desc: At Lasa, every brownie is crafted by hand using our signature blend of premium cocoa, real butter, and slow-baked goodness. We don’t mass-produce — we hand-make each batch, ensuring the perfect fudge center, crackly top, and deep chocolate flavour our customers cherish.
textEdits.about-chip-text: Handmade with love by Lakshitha in Bangalore
textEdits.about-title: A Slice of Happiness in Every Creation.
textEdits.about-desc: At Lasa Chocolates, every confection is crafted with genuine love and care. Our artisanal approach ensures that each piece is a little burst of happiness wrapped in sweetness. Founded in 2025, we believe in keeping our confections pure, honest, and delightfully balanced.
textEdits.point-1-desc: We choose thoughtful, eco-friendly food-grade packaging that respects our planet and minimizes environmental impact.
textEdits.point-2-desc: Proudly home-grown and founded by Lakshitha. When you choose Lasa, you directly empower local women artisans in Bangalore.
textEdits.point-3-desc: From slow-roasting premium dry fruits to hand-tempering delicate chocolate swirls, every batch is made fresh on demand.
textEdits.downloads-desc: Keep our full price card on your device or share with family and friends.
textEdits.order-desc: “Just submit the form or drop us a message — the rest we will take care with all our love! 💖”
textEdits.news-desc: Sign up for our email list for festival updates, seasonal fruit drops, and exclusive discounts.
